system.alertContribution: +1 per round while on the map
system.senses: A flashlight and a professional's habit of checking corners.
system.passive: Only appears once the Alert has reached Lockdown (7+), and only if the ST decides the humans called someone.
system.weakness: Can't fit anywhere small; leaves once the job looks done.
system.notes: Note: a Spray that lands drops a Vitality level; a spider caught in the open by one is Out.
system.biography:
“Came Prepared.”

The end-of-the-line threat. If the Exterminator is on the map, the crew's situation has already gone badly sideways.
